summary: Recycle the Canoe first: it returns 3 Logs, half of the log objective, and clears the optional objective before it is forgotten. Then build the Lumberjacks' Base (6 Sticks) with the 8 Sticks on the ground and the Foragers' Hut (9 Sticks) once fallen sticks from the apple trees make up the difference.

build_order.note: 6 Sticks; the 8 starting Sticks cover it. Its Logs plus the Canoe's 3 finish the 6-Log objective.
9 Sticks; wait for trees to drop more Sticks. Place it among the six Apple Trees so the three villagers stay fed.

pitfalls: Recycle the Canoe before anything else: it is the optional objective and 3 free Logs.
Two buildings need 15 Sticks but only 8 start on the map; the rest come from sticks the trees drop over time, so don't spend Sticks on anything else.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
